allow_filesystem_mark.description: When this option is set to 1, it allows fapolicyd to monitor file access events on bind mounted or overlayed file systems.

db_max_size.description: This option controls how many megabytes to allow the trust database to grow to.

debug_enabled.description: This option is either a 0 to mean send policy decisions to the kernel for enforcement. Or it can be a 1 to mean always allow the access even if policy would block it. Use only for policy testing and debug.

detailed_report.description: This option controls whether fapolicyd should add subject and object information to the usage statistics report.

do_stat_report.description: This option controls whether fapolicyd should create a usage statistics report on shutdown.

gid.description: This can be a number or a group name which fapolicyd should switch to during startup.

integrity.description: This option tells fapolicyd which integrity strategy it should use.

nice_val.description: This option gives fapolicyd a scheduler boost. The number can be from 0 to 20.

obj_cache_size.description: This option controls how many entries the object cache holds.

permissive.description: This option is either a 0 to mean send policy decisions to the kernel for enforcement. Or it can be a 1 to mean always allow the access even if policy would block it.

q_size.description: This option is used to control how big of an internal queue that fapolicyd will use.

report_interval.description: This option specifies a reporting interval, measured in seconds, which fapolicyd uses to schedule a recurring dump of internal performance statistics.

rpm_sha256_only.description: The option set to 1 forces the daemon to work only with SHA256 hashes.

subj_cache_size.description: This option controls how many entries the subject cache holds.

syslog_format.description: This option controls how the output from the access decision is formatted.

trust.description: This is a comma separated list of trust back-ends.

uid.description: This can be a number or an account name which fapolicyd should switch to during startup.

watch_fs.description: This is a comma separated list of file systems that should be watched.
